description: >
    Implement to specify a special mode of operation

properties:
    - name: SpecialMode
      type: enum[self.Modes]
      description: >
          The special mode.

enumerations:
    - name: Modes
      description: >
          Possible modes available.
      values:
          - name: None
            description: >
                BMC is under normal working condition.
          - name: Manufacturing
            description: >
                Indicate that BMC is in manufacturing mode and is allowed to
                perform any manufacturing related activity
          - name: ValidationUnsecure
            description: >
                Indicate that BMC is in validation mode, and can execute any
                special validation related commands

description: >
    Implement to provide PCIe channel transaction counters.
properties:
    - name: OutboundReadPktCount
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Outbound read Transaction Layer Packets count.
    - name: OutboundWritePktCount
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Outbound write Transaction Layer Packets count.
    - name: OutboundTLPCount
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Outbound completion TLP count.
    - name: OutboundReadTransfer
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The DWORDs transferred in outbound read transactions.
    - name: OutboundWriteTransfer
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The DWORDs transferred in outbound write transactions.
    - name: OutboundTLPsTransfer
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The DWORDs transferred in outbound completion TLPs.
    - name: ReqDroppedTag
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Read requests dropped due to tag unavailability.
    - name: ReqDroppedCreditCompletion
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Read requests dropped due to completion credit exhaustion.
    - name: ReqDroppedNonPostCredit
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Read requests dropped due to non-posted credit exhaustion.

    - name: InboundTLPCount
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The total number of Inbound completion TLPs count.

    - name: InboundTLPsTransfer
      type: uint64
      default: 0
      description: >
          The bytes transferred in inbound completion TLPs.

description: >
    Implement to represent properties related to Identity Authentication using
    SPDM protocol.

properties:
    - name: ResponderVerificationStatus
      type: enum[self.VerificationStatus]
      default: Unknown
      description: >
          The status of the verification of the identity of the component.

associations:
    - name: requester_identitified_by
      description: >
          Objects that implement IdentityAuthentication can implement the
          "requester_identified_by" association to provide a link to the target
          certificate that provides the requester's identity.
      reverse_name: identifying_requester
      required_endpoint_interfaces:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Certs.Certificate

    - name: responder_identitified_by
      description: >
          Objects that implement IdentityAuthentication can implement the
          "responder_identified_by" association to provide a link to the target
          certificate that provides the responder's identity.
      reverse_name: identifying_responder
      required_endpoint_interfaces:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Certs.Certificate

enumerations:
    - name: VerificationStatus
      description: >
          The possible status of the verification.
      values:
          - name: Failed
            description: >
                Unsuccessful verification.
          - name: Success
            description: >
                Successful verification.
          - name: Unknown
            description: >
                Status not known yet.

description: >
    Certificate management interface to install server and client certificates.
methods:
    - name: Install
      description: >
          Install the certificate and restart the associated services.
          NotAllowed error thrown if certificate already exists.
      parameters:
          - name: Path
            type: string
            description: >
                Path of file that contains both the certificate public and
                private key. (Example: a .PEM file containing both signed
                certificate and private key).

      returns:
          - name: ObjectPath
            type: string
            description: >
                D-Bus object path to created object.

      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Certs.Error.InvalidCertificate
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Certs.Error.CertificateLimitReached

description: >
    Manages rsyslog actions. Creates up to 10 RsyslogFwd objects per LogType.
    Each object is identified by its LogType and Index: fwd_<LogType>_<Index>.
    Contains 2 methods of object creation: CreateRsyslogFwd, which returns the next
    available index, and CreateRsyslogFwdIndex, which allows specifying the index if available.

methods:
    - name: CreateRsyslogFwd
      description: >
          Creates a new RsyslogFwd object fwd_<LogType>_<Index> representing an rsyslog fwd action.
          Returns an index which is used as the object identifier within fwd_<LogType>.
          Generates an error in cases of internal failure, operation not allowed (when the
          number of objects reaches the limit), or invalid argument.
      parameters:
          - name: LogType
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.LogType]
            description: >
                The log type of the new action.
          - name: Enabled
            type: boolean
            default: false
            description: >
                The new fwd action is enabled/disabled.
          - name: TransportProtocol
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.TransportProtocol]
            description: >
                The transport protocol of the new fwd action.
          - name: NetworkProtocol
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.NetworkProtocol]
            description: >
                The network protocol of the new fwd action.
          - name: Address
            type: string
            description: >
                The IP address used by the new fwd action in IPv4 or IPv6 format.
          - name: Port
            type: uint16
            description: >
                The port number which is used for the transport.
      returns:
          - name: Index
            type: size
            description: >
                The index of the new action which is used as the identifier of the action
                in the fwd_<LogType> conf file.
      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed


    - name: CreateRsyslogFwdIndex
      description: >
          Creates a new RsyslogFwd object fwd_<LogType>_<Index> representing an rsyslog fwd action.
          The index, which is used as the object identifier within fwd_<LogType>, is received as an
          argument and must be a legal value from 0 to 9.
          Generates an error in cases of internal failure, operation not allowed (i.e., Index is illegal
          or already in use), or invalid argument.
      parameters:
          - name: Index
            type: size
            description: >
                The index of the new action, which is used as the identifier of the action
                in the fwd_<LogType> conf file. Limited to 9.
          - name: LogType
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.LogType]
            description: >
                The log type of the new action.
          - name: Enabled
            type: boolean
            default: true
            description: >
                The new fwd action is enabled/disabled.
          - name: TransportProtocol
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.TransportProtocol]
            description: >
                The transport protocol of the new fwd action.
          - name: NetworkProtocol
            type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.Logging.RsyslogFwd.NetworkProtocol]
            description: >
                The network protocol of the new fwd action.
          - name: Address
            type: string
            description: >
                The IP address used by the new fwd action in IPv4 or IPv6 format.
          - name: Port
            type: uint16
            description: >
                The port number which is used for the transport.
      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed

description: >
  Implement to provide install and erase debug token functionalities for NSM
  devices.

enumerations:
  - name: EraseType
    description: >
      Enum describing debug token erase types.
    values:
      - name: TokenType
        description: >
          Erase a specific token type.
      - name: EraseAll
        description: >
          Erase all tokens.
      - name: EraseAllAndRatchetCounterIncreased
        description: >
          Erase all tokens and increment ratchet counter.

methods:
  - name: EraseToken
    description: >
      Erase installed token.
    parameters:
      - name: EraseType
        type: enum[self.EraseType]
        description: >
          Type of erase operation. Set to TokenType to erase a specific token type,
          EraseAll to erase all tokens, or EraseAllAndRatchetCounterIncreased to
          erase all tokens and increment the ratchet counter.
      - name: TokenType
        type: enum[com.nvidia.DebugToken.Common.Types]
        description: >
          Type of the token to erase when EraseType is TokenType. Ignored for other
          EraseType values.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: InstallToken
    description: >
      Install signed token.
    parameters:
      - name: TokenData
        type: unixfd
        description: >
          Memory file descriptor containing the TLV encoded token data.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

description: >
  Implement to provide DOT (Device Ownership Transfer) functionalities.

properties:
  - name: DOTState
    type: enum[self.DOTStates]
    default: Unknown
    description: >
      Current DOT state of the device.

methods:
  - name: DotCAKInstall
    description: >
      Install DOT CAK (Code Authentication Key).
    parameters:
      - name: CakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          CAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: CakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: CakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK LMS key data.
      - name: LakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          LAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: LakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: LakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK LMS key data.
      - name: LockDisable
        type: boolean
        description: >
          Lock disable flag (false: lock enabled, true: lock disabled).
      - name: OwnerMinSvn
        type: byte
        description: >
          Owner-defined Minimum Security Version Number used to verify
          the owner firmware security version in the Internal Root of Trust (IRoT).
      - name: VendorMinSvn
        type: byte
        description: >
          Vendor-defined Minimum Security Version Number used to verify the vendor
          firmware security version in the Internal Root of Trust (IRoT).
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: Bypass
    description: >
      Bypass DOT CAK installation. This method allows bypassing the 
      DOT authentication requirement.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: UnlockChallenge
    description: >
      Request an unlock challenge from the device prior to unlock operations.
    parameters:
      - name: UnlockType
        type: enum[self.UnlockType]
        description: >
          Unlock operation type.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: Unlock
    description: >
      Unlock DOT to transition from locked to volatile state or disabled to uninitialized state.
    parameters:
      - name: UnlockSignatureAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          Signature authentication scheme.
      - name: ECDSASignature
        type: string
        description: >
          ECDSA signature.
      - name: LMSSignature
        type: string
        description: >
          LMS signature.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: Lock
    description: >
      Lock DOT to transition from volatile state to locked state.
    parameters:
      - name: CakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          CAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: CakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: CakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK LMS key data.
      - name: LakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          LAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: LakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: LakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK LMS key data.
      - name: UnlockMethod
        type: enum[self.UnlockMethod]
        description: >
          Unlock method for lock operation.
      - name: StaticChallenge
        type: string
        description: >
          Required when UnlockMethod is StaticValue
      - name: LockSignatureAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          Signature authentication scheme.
      - name: ECDSASignature
        type: string
        description: >
          ECDSA signature.
      - name: LMSSignature
        type: string
        description: >
          LMS signature.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: GetInfo
    description: >
      Get DOT information including version, fuse state, and DOT blob.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: CAKRotate
    description: >
      Rotate the locked CAK without causing a DOT FUSE State change.
      The command is signed by LAK (priv component). The old DOT Blob for
      the prior CAK would still be usable as the DOT FUSE State did not alter.
      The new dot blob will be returned to BMC upon ack DOT_CAK_ROTATE command.
    parameters:
      - name: CakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          CAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: CakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: CakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          CAK LMS key data.
      - name: CAKRotateSignatureAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          Signature authentication scheme.
      - name: ECDSASignature
        type: string
        description: >
          ECDSA signature.
      - name: LMSSignature
        type: string
        description: >
          LMS signature.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: RecoverDOT
    description: >
      This method is used only when DOT is corrupted in device and user has backup DOT.
      Upon sending the DOT blob device will validate and recovers the DOT by updating
      DOT blob in the device.
    parameters:
      - name: DOTData
        type: unixfd
        description: >
          File descriptor containing backup DOT data.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: Override
    description: >
      Override DOT to reset ownership state when valid DOT data can no longer be recovered.
      Requires vendor signature signed by Nvidia vendor key. UnlockChallenge with
      VendorUnlock type should be used prior to Override.
    parameters:
      - name: VendorSignatureAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          Vendor signature authentication scheme.
      - name: ECDSASignature
        type: string
        description: >
          ECDSA signature with challenge from UnlockChallenge.
      - name: LMSSignature
        type: string
        description: >
          LMS signature with challenge from UnlockChallenge.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

  - name: Disable
    description: >
      Disable DOT to transition from uninitialized state to disabled state.
    parameters:
      - name: LakKeyAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          LAK key authentication scheme.
      - name: LakEcdsaKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK ECDSA key data.
      - name: LakLmsKey
        type: string
        description: >
          LAK LMS key data.
      - name: UnlockMethod
        type: enum[self.UnlockMethod]
        description: >
          Unlock method for disable operation.
      - name: StaticChallenge
        type: string
        description: >
          Required when Unlock_Method is StaticValue.
      - name: DisableSignatureAuthScheme
        type: enum[self.KeyAuthScheme]
        description: >
          Signature authentication scheme.
      - name: ECDSASignature
        type: string
        description: >
          ECDSA signature.
      - name: LMSSignature
        type: string
        description: >
          LMS signature.
    errors:
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InternalFailure
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.InvalidArgument
      - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.Unavailable
    returns:
      - name: ObjectPath
        type: object_path
        description: >
            DBus object path of the async operation status object.
            Interface com.nvidia.Async.Status at this returned object path
            can be used to retrieve the status of the operation.

enumerations:
  - name: KeyAuthScheme
    description: >
      Key authentication scheme types for DOT operations.
    values:
      - name: Ecdsa
        description: >
          ECDSA-only authentication scheme.
      - name: Hybrid
        description: >
          Hybrid ECDSA+LMS authentication scheme.

  - name: UnlockType
    description: >
      Type of unlock operation for DOT unlock challenge.
    values:
      - name: OwnerUnlock
        value: 1
        description: >
          Owner unlock type, indicates an owner calling DOT_UNLOCK.
      - name: VendorUnlock
        value: 2
        description: >
          Vendor unlock type, indicates a vendor calling DOT_OVERRIDE.

  - name: UnlockMethod
    description: >
      Unlock method for lock operation.
    values:
      - name: DeviceUniqueIdentifier
        description: >
          Per-device unique identifier.
      - name: RandomNonce
        description: >
          Randomly generated nonce.
      - name: StaticValue
        description: >
          Static value provided during lock or disable.

  - name: DOTStates
    description: >
      DOT state values for the device.
    values:
      - name: Uninitialized
        description: >
          DOT is not initialized.
      - name: Volatile
        description: >
          DOT is in volatile state.
      - name: Locked
        description: >
          DOT is in mutable locked state.
      - name: Disabled
        description: >
          DOT is in mutable disabled state.
      - name: Unknown
        description: >
          DOT state is unknown or cannot be determined.

description: >
    This interface defines methods and properties required for Time-based
    One-time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication at user level to
    support multi-factor authentication secret key setup for each user. This
    interface implemented by each user object to support TOTP based
    authenticators like google, microsoft, etc.

methods:
    - name: CreateSecretKey
      description: >
          This method setup Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) authenticator
          secret key for the given user and returns secret key string to share
          secret key to user.
      returns:
          - name: SecretKey
            type: string
            description: >
                Secret key string which will be shared to user to setup TOTP
                applications to generate TOTP token.
      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.UnsupportedRequest
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed

    - name: VerifyOTP
      description: >
          This method verifies OTP with Time-based One-time Password
          authenticator secret key for the given user and returns weather this
          OTP is valid or not which make sure user has setup valid secret key
          for two factor authentication.
      parameters:
          - name: OTP
            type: string
            description: >
                One-time password string
      returns:
          - name: Status
            type: boolean
            description: >
                Returns true if provided OTP is valid otherwise returns false.
      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.UnsupportedRequest
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed

    - name: ClearSecretKey
      description: >
          This method clears Time-based One-time Password authenticator secret
          key for the given user.
      errors:
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.UnsupportedRequest
          - xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Error.NotAllowed
properties:
    - name: SecretKeyGenerationRequired
      type: boolean
      default: false
      flags:
          - readonly
      description: >
          This property indicates whether TOTP authenticator secret key setup
          required for the given user to complete Time-based One-time Password
          authentication setup

    - name: SecretKeyIsValid
      type: boolean
      default: false
      description: >
          This property indicates whether TOTP authenticator secret key setup
          for the given user

    - name: BypassedProtocol
      type: enum[xyz.openbmc_project.User.MultiFactorAuthConfiguration.Type]
      default: None
      description: >
          User level multi-factor authentication bypass settings. This interface
          will be implemented by user D-bus object to support user's MFA bypass
          configuration.

description: >
    Settings to clear or reset the security keys.

properties:
    - name: ClearHostSecurityKeys
      type: byte
      description: >
          This is a bit mask used to specify clearing different security keys or
          resetting those values back to default by the host. Setting this
          property does not guarantee a successful operation as additional
          conditions will be checked by the host to clear/reset the sensitive
          data. This property will be mapped to a new IPMI sensor.

          The new property is having an integer value and the default value will
          be zero. The end operation is determined by the bit value set and some
          of the customer use cases which maps to bit value are

          Bit 0 - Clear All : Clear/reset all the sensitive data controlled by
                  platform firmware from the system. System can generate new
                  data to re-enable the affected functions if required
          Bit 1 - Clear OS PK : This directs OPAL to clear the OS platform key
          Bit 2 - Clear PEF SSO : This directs OPAL/PEF to clear the
                  System Security Officer certificate
          Bit 3 - Clear PowerVM System Key : This directs PowerVM to reset the
                  system key back to the default state
          Bit 4-6 - Reserved

description: >
    Implement to specify a restricted mode of operation.

properties:
    - name: RestrictionMode
      type: enum[self.Modes]
      description: >
          The restriction mode.

enumerations:
    - name: Modes
      description: >
          Possible modes of restriction.
      values:
          - name: None
            description: >
                No restriction.
          - name: Allowlist
            description: >
                Allow, only if in the allowlist.
          - name: Blocklist
            description: >
                Prevent, if in the blocklist.
          - name: Provisioning
            description: >
                Indicate that system is in provisioning mode and all commands
                are allowed in system interface in both pre and post BIOS boot.
          - name: ProvisionedHostAllowlist
            description: >
                Commands in the allowlist will only be executed through system
                interface after BIOS POST complete. All KCS commands are
                supported before POST complete.
          - name: ProvisionedHostDisabled
            description: >
                Commands through system interface are executed only till BIOS
                POST complete notification, after which system interface
                commands are blocked (except BIOS SMI based ones).
